name: Chardonnay Romancia
original_name: シャルドネロマンシア
source:
In an idyllic town frequented by Heroes, there is a small guesthouse called the Grapes Inn that's (in)famous for a particular reason:

"Feel free to find another place to stay if you can't comply with the terms.
I'm sure there are many other inns suited for Heroes like you."

"I won't change my mind. Even if my inn will be the only one that will never let Heroes stay in it."

Its innkeeper, a young man named Rudolf, absolutely detests Heroes!
But one day, through some twist of fate, a Hero lands on his doorstep.

This stranger, Figaro, explains that he has lost all of his memories. Not only that, one look at Rudolf has made him fall in love at first sight!
Rudolf desperately tries to drive the pesky Hero away, but circumstances force him to hire Figaro as his helper instead.

"But I wanna staaay! I can be your helper! Pleeeeease?"

The timing couldn't have been worse as Rudolf already had his hands full with his other guests: Jey, a bibacious merchant, and Kinos, his taciturn bodyguard. To make things even more chaotic, Nazk, a young mage, just moved in to open an apothecary next door.

Furthermore, the threat of a notorious syndicate also looms on the horizon.
In this story of Heroes, debts, hot springs, festivals, tentacles, family, and an inn that must be protected at all costs, what does destiny have in store for this poor innkeeper?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841640/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在一座勇者经常造访的恬静小镇里，有家名为“葡萄旅馆”的小旅店，因某个特别的理由而远近闻名，也可能是臭名昭著。

“如果不能接受条件，请另找住处。
我相信，一定还有许多适合您这样的勇者的旅馆。”

“我不会改变主意。就算我的旅馆成了唯一一家绝不接待勇者的旅馆，也是一样。”

年轻店主鲁道夫，极其厌恶勇者！
然而某天，阴差阳错之下，一位勇者来到他的门前。

这位名叫费加罗的陌生人，声称自己失去了全部记忆。不仅如此，他只看了鲁道夫一眼，就一见钟情！
鲁道夫拼命想赶走这个烦人的勇者，却因情势所迫，不得不雇用费加罗做帮手。

“可是我想留下嘛！我可以帮忙！求——求你啦？”

偏偏这时，其他住客的事已经让鲁道夫忙得不可开交，有嗜酒的商人杰伊，还有他沉默寡言的保镖基诺斯。为了让局面更乱，年轻魔法师纳兹克也刚搬来，准备在隔壁开药铺。

此外，一个臭名昭著的犯罪集团，也逐渐构成威胁。
勇者、债务、温泉、庆典、触手、家人，以及一间必须拼死守护的旅馆，在这样的故事里，命运会为可怜的店主安排什么？
